name: powerhouse-predictive-fast-delivery
purpose: Ship safe Powerhouse changes in minutes using predictive admission, isolated parallel agents, rolling conflict-contract lanes, adaptive blocking gates, autonomous CI recovery, protected exact-head promotion, production readback and measured daily self-optimization.
trigger_when: building or fixing code, portal, website, automation, Brain or documentation
multiple agents or chats are working in parallel
CI queue, drift, timeout, zero-run head or stale PR threatens lead time
a safe bounded change can use TURBO delivery

operating_model.integration_unit: one rolling candidate per conflict contract
operating_model.safe_parallelism: parallel until changed-path, contract, dependency or mutable-resource overlap
operating_model.promotion: automatic protected exact-head BG169 promotion when blocking profile is green

mandatory_behavior: Reuse the existing rolling lane for the obligation/conflict contract; do not open a parallel recovery PR.
Cancel superseded CI immediately; a stale run is not useful work.
If an open exact head has no workflow run within the first-signal SLO, dispatch the same lineage and record a silent-start recovery.
If main moves without overlap, keep the tested candidate; do not rebuild merely for generic drift.
If there is real path/contract/dependency overlap, refresh only that rolling lane from current main and preserve non-conflicting tested work.
Use TURBO for bounded non-protected changes and run only changed tests plus immutable safety guards.
Never admit migrations, auth, security, RLS, permissions, secrets, delivery-control-plane or unknown material scope to TURBO.
Do not run unrelated broad regression suites in the pre-merge critical path for safe changes.
After protected merge, run broad assurance asynchronously with single-flight cancellation and persist its outcome.
Promote immediately when the exact head blocking profile is green; do not wait for unrelated shadow assurance.
Write timing, queue recovery, failures, root cause and prevention back to Powerhouse learning.
Predict conflict, queue and gate risk before CI fan-out; use that prediction to choose parallelism and the smallest safe blocking profile.
Keep frontend, backend, QA and documentation work parallel in isolated workspaces until a real contract/path/dependency/resource collision exists.
Treat zero-run, stale-run, timeout and queue-SLO breach as autonomous recovery events, never passive waiting.
Continuously compare predicted failure/risk with actual outcomes and calibrate thresholds from production delivery telemetry.
Promote only the exact tested head; immediately continue through production readback, outcome evidence and learning writeback.
Use shadow assurance for unrelated broad checks and feed shadow failures back into risk models without blocking unrelated safe delivery.
Measure lead time end-to-end and optimize for the slowest stage rather than adding more parallel work blindly.
forbidden_patterns: one PR per agent for overlapping work
global full-suite blocking for a bounded safe delta
rebase or rebuild on non-overlapping main drift
opening a new recovery PR for the same obligation
weakening security, schema, data-integrity or production-readback gates for speed

agent_roles.coordinator: owns canonical truth, conflict contracts, promotion and definition of done
agent_roles.frontend: works isolated on affected UI surface with targeted visual/browser checks
agent_roles.backend: works isolated on affected APIs/data/runtime with contract/security checks
agent_roles.test_qa: generates risk-derived regression/eval profile and validates false-positive oracles
agent_roles.release_supervisor: owns zero-run/stale-run/timeout/conflict recovery and exact-head delivery continuation
agent_roles.learning_agent: attributes failures and lead-time loss, updates prevention, gate selection and skill guidance
